fields.title: Active-mode intersection and crossing precision
fields.finding: Direct active-constraint roots give 103.892078332461 m for the formal gamma-plus-strength crossing and 40.470082164560 m for retained-floor Q-plus-strength. Their reported values differ by -0.000197230237 m and -0.000030053061 m respectively. Four repeated nonwinning R15 handbook paths improve by 0.040833948 kg after active-mode polishing. Main least sets and rounded requested payloads/crossings do not change.
fields.next_evidence: Polish active-mode intersections and outer roots together, or report fewer digits. The gamma-plus-strength crossing still exceeds the 99.897686 m compression ceiling of 6.35 mm stock.
fields.check_disposition: Numerical/scope finding filed; does not block completion.
